description: Image Description: The image shows a bright orange, modern tour bus parked in a lot. The bus has a sleek, aerodynamic design with large windows and a prominent front windshield. The brand name "IRIZAR" is visible on the front of the bus. There are side mirrors extending from the sides, and the bus is parked on a paved surface adjacent to another bus, which is partially visible on the left. The bus is labeled with "yakobus" in the bottom right corner of the image
